mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals an active monetary tightening cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.5% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy and suppressing equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20d returns in more than 60% of cases when UNRATE < 4.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction starts above 1.3 million units signals strong household demand and rising inflationary pressure, which leads to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX delivers positive 20d returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 1300.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 114.0 indicates weakening manufacturing activity and a contraction in real output, which signals an impending economic slowdown and triggers risk-off behavior, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in more than 60% of cases when INDPRO < 114.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both residential construction starts and real personal consumption expenditures signals strong aggregate demand, which raises inflation expectations and leads to a higher probability of Fed rate hikes, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20d returns in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST > 1300.0 and RSAFS > 375000.0, or the interaction Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in payroll employment and decline in unemployment rate signals a labor market that is both expanding and tightening, increasing wage pressures and inflation expectations, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX delivers positive 20d returns in more than 60% of cases when PAYEMS > 138000.0 and UNRATE < 4.8%, or the interaction Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the CPI inflation rate above 3.0% signals persistent inflationary pressures that prevent the Fed from cutting rates, leading to elevated discount rates and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 207.5, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained expansion in real GDP growth above 2.0% annualized, as measured by the quarterly GDP series, signals strong economic momentum that supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX delivers negative 60d returns in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 > 11500.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.
